mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, vault_uuid, vault_external_id, user_uuid, COALESCE(user_external_id, '') AS user_external_id, COALESCE(platform_session_external_id, '') AS platform_session_external_id, mcp_server_url, redirect_url, display_name, source, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, COALESCE(registration_endpoint, '') AS registration_endpoint, COALESCE(issuer, '') AS issuer, resource, COALESCE(scope, '') AS scope, client_id, client_credential_source, token_endpoint_auth_method, code_challenge_method, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, status, COALESCE(credential_external_id, '') AS credential_external_id, COALESCE(error_code, '') AS error_code, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_oauth_flows ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, vault_uuid, vault_external_id, user_uuid, user_external_id, platform_session_external_id, mcp_server_url, redirect_url, display_name, source, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, registration_endpoint, issuer, resource, scope, client_id, client_credential_source, token_endpoint_auth_method, code_challenge_method, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.VaultUUID}, #{params.VaultExternalID}, #{params.UserUUID}, NULLIF(#{params.UserExternalID}, ''), NULLIF(#{params.PlatformSessionExternalID}, ''), #{params.MCPServerURL}, #{params.RedirectURL}, #{params.DisplayName}, #{params.Source}, #{params.AuthorizationEndpoint}, #{params.TokenEndpoint}, NULLIF(#{params.RegistrationEndpoint}, ''), NULLIF(#{params.Issuer}, ''), #{params.Resource}, NULLIF(#{params.Scope}, ''), #{params.ClientID}, #{params.ClientCredentialSource}, #{params.TokenEndpointAuthMethod}, #{params.CodeChallengeMethod}, #{params.Ciphertext,sensitive=true}, #{params.Nonce,sensitive=true}, #{params.WrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, #{params.FormatVersion}, #{params.KeyProvider}, #{params.KeyVersion}, #{params.Status}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.ExpiresAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_oauth_flows SET status = 'completed', credential_external_id = #{credentialExternalID}, error_code = NULL, ciphertext = NULL, nonce = NULL, wrapped_dek = NULL, format_version = NULL, key_provider = NULL, key_version = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE mcp_oauth_flows SET status = 'failed', error_code = #{errorCode}, ciphertext = NULL, nonce = NULL, wrapped_dek = NULL, format_version = NULL, key_provider = NULL, key_version = NULL, updated_at = #{failedAt} WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND status = 'pending'
